en: Hungarian Rhapsody: Queen Live in Budapest
orig: Hungarian Rhapsody: Queen Live in Budapest ’86
plotEn:
Queen: Budapest is a concert film of the performance at the Népstadion in Budapest on 27 July 1986 by the British rock band Queen. It was part of The Magic Tour, the band's final tour with their original lead singer Freddie Mercury. The 2012 release title is a play on the Hungarian Rhapsodies by Franz Liszt and one of Queen's most celebrated hits, "Bohemian Rhapsody".
The performance has been released in multiple titles including Queen – Live in Budapest (1987) and Hungarian Rhapsody: Queen Live
